value.rationale: A natural open subfamily explicitly left outside a recent S-gap perturbation theorem receives a sharp quantitative answer for arbitrary nonsofic gap sets and unequal cutoffs. The two-tail product law explains the order of rare-hole entropy loss and its striking exact plateaus and super-exponential jumps for lacunary sets.
